Predicting Concentration Value - Predicted the concentration value for a spectrum dataset using PCA and SVM Regressor. Principal Component Analysis was used to reduce the dimensionality of the dataset and replicate the functionalities of an existing tool including the Hotelling T2 plots. CLASSIFICATION

RSC - Developed a proof-of-concept that used FastText and Jaccard Similarity to generate a maximum similarity score between two addresses above the threshold limit and assign the address to the predictive field. Applied standard text cleaning techniques to remove special characters and punctuation. Project assigned to Physical Manufacturer.

Insights - Key Phrase Extraction & Summary - Developed and deployed a model for key phrase extraction and summarizing customer reviews and complaints. Used TF-IDF and Word & Sentence Tokenization to clean and analyze the text, and generated summaries based on a threshold limit. Deployed Model in an in-house platform and the output were very useful to the end user

TIME SERIES

Forecasting OEE - Developed a forecasting model for Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) of different machines using XGBoost. Used key fields that decide the OEE value of the machines and the data was stored in a database. The training and prediction codes were deployed into an Azure Virtual Machine and a cron-job was created to run the codes as per the requirements. The model was saved into Azure Blob Storage and also created CI/CD pipelines for deployment

Anomaly Detection of Sensors – Led anomaly detection of sensors by using static thresholding. Analyzed IOT data received from sensors and used it to forecast anomalies. Fixed a threshold limit of temperature and classified those points as anomalies.

IMAGE CLASSIFICATION

Contact Lens Defect Identification - Developed an automated defect recognition tool for contact lenses using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with RELU activation. The images were converted to black and white using adaptive thresholding and morphological operations such as MORPH_RECT, erode and dilate were used to detect any lines in the contact lens images. The model achieved an accuracy of 98%, reducing costs and manual effort by 70%

Digital Calibration Frequency - Designed, developed and deployed a linear regression model for predicting the number of days for the next calibration of devices, using Weibull Analysis and Azure Databricks. Automated CI/CD pipelines to handle changes without manual intervention

The model was saved into Azure Blob Storage and also created CI/CD pipelines for deployment
